description.en: Coastal hydrochemistry analysis, trend analysis step: performs Mann–Kendall trend tests and Sen's slope estimation for river and marine time series.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: List of variable names to process.

variable_units.title: Variable units
variable_units.description: List of variable=unit pairs giving the unit of each variable.

non_mass_vars.title: Non-mass variables
non_mass_vars.description: List of variable names that are not mass concentrations (e.g. pH, temperature) and therefore must not be converted to loads or fluxes.

river_flux_dir.title: River flux directory
river_flux_dir.description: TODO: How to pass this? Folder containing daily river-flux NetCDF files, used when trends are run without the flux estimation step.

marine_input.title: Marine input
marine_input.description: Marine chemistry NetCDF file or OPeNDAP URL.

trend_frequency.title: Trend frequency
trend_frequency.description: Temporal resolution of the trend analysis: 'config', 'monthly', 'annual' or 'seasonal_by_season'.

mk_mode.title: Mann-Kendall mode
mk_mode.description: Mode of the Mann-Kendall trend test: 'auto', 'original' or 'seasonal'.

trend_start_year.title: Trend start year
trend_start_year.description: Optional first year of the trend-analysis period.

trend_end_year.title: Trend end year
trend_end_year.description: Optional last year of the trend-analysis period.

trend_require_full_period.title: Require full trend period
trend_require_full_period.description: If true, the complete requested trend period must be covered by the data.

trend_alpha.title: Trend significance level
trend_alpha.description: Significance level (alpha) of the Mann-Kendall test. Must be strictly between 0 and 1.

trend_min_points_monthly.title: Minimum points for monthly trends
trend_min_points_monthly.description: Minimum number of points required for monthly trend analysis.

trend_min_points_annual.title: Minimum points for annual trends
trend_min_points_annual.description: Minimum number of points required for annual trend analysis.

trend_min_points_seasonal.title: Minimum points for seasonal trends
trend_min_points_seasonal.description: Minimum number of points required for seasonal trend analysis.

river_min_obs_monthly.title: River: minimum observations per month
river_min_obs_monthly.description: Minimum number of daily river values required to create a monthly value. River flux values are aggregated by summation.

river_min_obs_annual.title: River: minimum observations per year
river_min_obs_annual.description: Minimum number of daily river values required to create an annual value. River flux values are aggregated by summation.

river_min_obs_seasonal.title: River: minimum observations per season
river_min_obs_seasonal.description: Minimum number of daily river values required to create a seasonal value. River flux values are aggregated by summation.

marine_depth_min.title: Marine minimum depth
marine_depth_min.description: Minimum marine sampling depth in metres. The default AquaINFRA configuration selects measurements from 0-10 m unless the depth limits are overridden.

marine_depth_max.title: Marine maximum depth
marine_depth_max.description: Maximum marine sampling depth in metres. The default AquaINFRA configuration selects measurements from 0-10 m unless the depth limits are overridden.

marine_min_obs_monthly.title: Marine: minimum observations per month
marine_min_obs_monthly.description: Minimum number of marine observations required to create a monthly value. Marine chemistry values are aggregated using the median.

marine_min_obs_annual.title: Marine: minimum observations per year
marine_min_obs_annual.description: Minimum number of marine observations required to create an annual value. Marine chemistry values are aggregated using the median.

marine_min_obs_seasonal.title: Marine: minimum observations per season
marine_min_obs_seasonal.description: Minimum number of marine observations required to create a seasonal value. Marine chemistry values are aggregated using the median.

marine_require_all_seasons.title: Marine: require all seasons
marine_require_all_seasons.description: If true, all seasons are required when creating annual marine values.

marine_min_seasons_per_year.title: Marine: minimum seasons per year
marine_min_seasons_per_year.description: Minimum number of seasons (0 to 4) required to create an annual marine value.

marine_station_dim.title: Marine station dimension
marine_station_dim.description: Name of the station dimension in the marine input.

marine_station_coord.title: Marine station coordinate
marine_station_coord.description: Name of the station-name coordinate in the marine input.

marine_depth_dim.title: Marine depth dimension
marine_depth_dim.description: Name of the depth dimension or coordinate in the marine input.
